pages.text: Timing varies by preset. Use this as an escalation guide, not a day count.$(br2)A $(l:heating/phase_barometer)Phase Barometer$(/l) forecasts in-world.

pages.title: Phase 0-1
pages.text: $(bold)Normal:$() no effects. Prepare.$(br2)$(bold)Twilight:$() the sun shrinks and it cools slightly. Clear spells shorten, rain lasts longer, thunder is rare. Your last clear look at the sun.

pages.title: Phase 2
pages.text: $(bold)Cooling, -10°C.$()$(br2)Constant rain or snow. Water freezes; plants die.

pages.title: Phase 3
pages.text: $(bold)The Long Night, -25°C.$()$(br2)Constant storms and fog. Lava starts to cool. $(danger)The surface turns dangerous.$()

pages.title: Phase 4
pages.text: $(bold)Deep Freeze, -45°C.$()$(br2)$(danger)The surface is lethal.$() Obsidian freezes, coal ore crystallizes. Dense fog, near darkness.

pages.title: Phase 5
pages.text: $(bold)Eternal Winter, -70°C to -120°C.$()$(br2)Permanent midnight and whiteout. $(danger)Only deep underground is survivable.$()

pages.title: Phase 6
pages.text: $(bold)Atmospheric Collapse, -120°C to -273°C.$()$(li)Early: extreme blizzard$(li)Mid: air thins, wind dies, fog lifts$(li)Late: $(danger)vacuum$(). Stars, silence, sublimating ice
In late Phase 6 you can only breathe in a sealed, breathable room.$(br2)Core and Blast Pit oxygen needs a closed room.
